youtube.description:
Uncle ne poocha: "Meri sugar zyada hai, kya operation ruk jaayega?" 😟
Dr Saathi ne kaha: kabhi-kabhi Uncle! Pehle sugar control, phir safe operation. 💚

Sach kya hai?
✅ Sugar bahut zyada ho toh planned operation kuch samay ke liye tal sakta hai, taaki pehle sugar control ho
✅ Zyada sugar se operation ke baad infection jaisi pareshaani ka khatra badhta hai
✅ Zaroorat ho toh operation ke dauraan aur baad mein bhi sugar control mein rakhi jaati hai
✅ Sugar ki dawa ya insulin kab leni hai, yeh apne doctor ki batayi timing se hi kijiye
Koi bhi sawaal ho, apne doctor se poochhiye.
